2610.08355.title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
2610.08355.paper_summary: Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior
2610.08355.paper_summary_zh: 流匹配模型從各向同性的高斯源開始，這是當數據的相關結構事先未知時的標準選擇。然而，對於多通道腦電圖記錄，這部分結構是事先已知的。電極固定在頭部的特定位置，通過顱骨和頭皮的體積傳導使得相鄰的電極以一種在不同受試者之間共享的方式共同變化。現有的腦電圖生成模型仍然讓網絡從零開始學習這一點。我們將這一結構直接放入源中。僅根據傳感器坐標，我們構建了一個k最近鄰圖，並將其拉普拉斯算子的圖-馬特恩函數作為源協方差，因此流從空間一致的模式開始，而不是通道獨立的噪聲。這一變化不增加任何學習參數，適用於任何耦合和任何漂移網絡，並在每個數據集上使用相同的三個超參數。在八個腦電圖數據集和四種流匹配方法中，圖-馬特恩源降低了生成信號與真實信號之間在五個臨床頻段（PSD-KL）的頻譜差異，對於大多數數據集而言。根據方法的不同，PSD-KL在數據集上的幾何平均下降了12%到17%，在PhysioNet-MI這個最密集的佈局上則下降了最多40%。我們顯示，這一改進源於傳感器位置的局部圖的空間特徵向量，因為在保留特徵值譜的同時隨機化特徵向量會消除增益。此外，直接擬合到經驗數據協方差的先驗表現不如各向同性噪聲。相同的構造不變地適用於MEG、具有患者特定網格的顱內腦電圖以及交通傳感器網絡，降低每種方法在每個數據集上的PSD-KL。 https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior
